run_single_point_orca_calculation: run a single-point energy calculation using ORCA with a specified XC functional and basis set
run_geometry_optimization_orca: run a geometry optimization using ORCA with customizable optimizer parameters and step counter
run_orca_calculation_with_nbo: run an ORCA single-point calculation with Natural Bond Orbital analysis enabled
